note: Re-read RFC 2661 Section 5.8 ('If no peer response is detected after several retransmissions, (a recommended default is 5, but SHOULD be configurable), the tunnel and all sessions within MUST be cleared.') after commit 1cd941a108 changed locateTunnelLocked and handleDial. That change replaced the inline max-tunnels test with tunnelSlotsFullLocked (live tunnels plus discarded tunnels still holding unconfirmed session cleanups) and the maxSessions assignment with bindTunnelAdmissionLocked (maxSessions plus the confirmed-cleanup pruner). Neither touches retransmission: both constructors still pass r.reliableConfig() to newTunnel, so the configured budget still reaches each new tunnel's ReliableEngine, and Tick still exhausts it. ExtractParameters, tunnelDefaults, reliableConfig and setMaxRetransmit are unchanged. The tagged unit is byte-identical: TestRFC2661ConfiguredMaxRetransmitClearsTunnel builds its reactor with MaxTunnels 0 (limit math.MaxUint16, no retained cleanups), so the new admission gate admits its SCCRQ exactly as before; it sets max-retransmit 2 before the tunnel exists, disables HELLO dead-peer detection, asserts Established through each allowed retransmission (negative: premature clearing fails) and Closed on the next deadline (positive: a fixed five fails). Discard now also calls markTunnelDiscardedLocked, which only counts retained cleanups and leaves state Closed, so the asserted clearing is unaffected.
